scope: Actual blocking queue-send timeout graph through heap, ordered wait/list placement, suspend/resume, critical and tick providers, including tick/overflow-list wrap and mutex-layout task canaries
limitations: PendSV is observed and execution paused; tick calls run on a controlled separate stack and saved task CPU context is restored. This models scheduling transfer, not the native PendSV/context-switch implementation. Task state is a controlled104-byte prefix with preserved tail; full task construction, event-driven producer/consumer wakeups, physical concurrency and whole-image identity remain gates.
